svg.metadata: {"source_asset": {"id": "core.model.nematode", "name": "Nematode Model", "category": "model-system", "tags": ["nematode", "worm model", "c elegans", "invertebrate model", "genetics", "model organism"], "description": "Original vector generic nematode model with a smooth C-shaped body path, differentiated head cue, restrained internal tract, and editable semantic regions.", "file": "svg/nematode_model.svg", "source_type": "original_vector_draft", "license": "CC0-1.0", "provenance": "Original Figure Studio vector asset drawn from generic nematode model-organism morphology; no proprietary library artwork, organism-specific reference image, scraping, tracing, or protected asset recreation was used.", "style_family": "figure-studio-soft-line-v1", "review_status": "visual_reviewed_2026_07_20", "style_status": "soft_line_v1_model_organism_batch_1", "mvp_quality": "curated", "editable_region_count": 4, "reviewer_notes": "The open C-shaped body, differentiated head cue, and restrained central tract produce a generic nematode-model read without encoding species, sex, age, developmental stage, genotype, treatment, anatomy-specific labeling, or phenotype.", "editable_color_regions": [{"id": "body", "label": "Nematode body", "default": "#F4E8C1", "paint": "stroke"}, {"id": "internal_tract", "label": "Internal tract cue", "default": "#B89CD9", "paint": "stroke"}, {"id": "head", "label": "Head cue", "default": "#F4A261", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "outline", "label": "Body and head outline", "default": "#26323D", "paint": "stroke"}]}, "source_svg": "scientific-packs/core-biology/svg/nematode_model.svg", "source_archive": "scientific-packs(1).zip", "output_style": "Style 4", "batch": "009", "source_metadata_is_unmodified": true, "source_review_status_applies_to_original_only": true}
